Zara_CS: FYI Skybridge onboarding - their APAC demo tomorrow AM is tripping edge RLs in singapore. They asked for a short-lived config tweak (2h). Can ops handle an ephemeral allowlist + regional pin? :pray:
Miro_CSM: This is on our renewal playbook. If demo latency improves we move the account from at-risk -> on-track. Please add a tiny blurb for AE and I'll join the demo.
Jae_Ops: I can do it. Plan: pin demo header flows to ap-southeast-1, add two demo IPs to an ephemeral allowlist, bump burst to 800 rps for 2h, autorevoke TTL=3h. Fallback region to ap-northeast-1 after 220ms p50.
Zara_CS: Demo runners will come from 198.51.101.210 and 198.51.101.211. They set header `X-SB-Demo: true`.
Rina_Engineer: Header-based routing supported. I'll push the rule to staging now and run a quick smoke. ETA 18m.
Tomas_SRE: Recommend a 10m KV cache pre-warm to prevent tokenization spikes. I'll run the warmup 10 minutes before start and watch p95. Abort if p95 regresses >10%.
Jae_Ops: I'll schedule pre-warm at T-10m and apply config at demo start. Ephemeral allowlist TTL=3h so it auto-revokes.
Zara_CS: Can you paste the exact config you'll apply so I can include in the AE note and renewal tracker?
Jae_Ops: Planned config (apply at 2025-01-15T01:00:00Z):

```
customer: "skybridge"
change_id: "3599990000-ephemeral"
allowlist_ips: ["198.51.101.210/32","198.51.101.211/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "ap-southeast-1", burst_rps: "800", window_start: "2025-01-15T01:00:00Z", window_end: "2025-01-15T03:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "3h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-SB-Demo", value: "true"}, primary_region: "ap-southeast-1", fallback: "ap-northeast-1", fallback_latency_ms: "220"}
```

Rina_Engineer: Snippet looks good. I'll validate on staging and post smoke metrics (latency, 5xx, token spend) here in ~18m.
Tomas_SRE: I'll run pre-warm and set short window alerting on p95 and token cost. If token cost spikes >20% or p95 regresses >10% we rollback and notify.
deploy-bot: change_request skybridge-3599990000 queued for manual approval by Jae_Ops at 2025-01-15T00:40:00Z
Jae_Ops: Approved. Pre-warm scheduled 00:50 UTC, apply at 01:00 UTC. Will post staging smoke + live smoke results and revoke timestamp when done.
Miro_CSM: Added renewal tracker note: "Skybridge demo with ephemeral ap-southeast-1 pin and rlift; positive outcome likely to reduce renewal risk." Also scheduling 10m AE prep call 25m before start.
Zara_CS: Thanks all 1 — please @channel any major regressions. I'll collect feedback from Skybridge PM after demo and paste notes here for the renewal dossier.
